| # Error Management Module {#error-management-module-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                 |                                                                                                                                     |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

An Error Management Module (EMM) which collects faults from different error sources and performs a configurable error reaction.

Remarks:

- DFCs are set when an error reaction has already taken place, so it is checked if an error has occurred in previous cycle.

- Refer [Safety function and safe state](safetyfunctionandsafestate.html){.topiclink} for details on the safety functions provided by the RCs and the related considerations to be observed.

- Refer [Failure detection possibilities](failuredetectionpossibilities.html){.topiclink} for a broader overview of the different failure reactions observed.

 

Error reaction:

+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| Error                             | Reaction                          |
+===================================+===================================+
| DFC                               | No                                |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| Error Code                        | No                                |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| High Power Outputs(\...,OFF)      | Yes                               |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| ECU Reset                         | Yes                               |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| Reaction time                     | 150 ms                            |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| Reset Reason - Group ID           | RESET_SWRESET_MOC                 |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| Reset Reason  - Reset number      | RBA_RESET_MOCEMM_WTCHK_FAILED/    |
|                                   |                                   |
|                                   | RBA_RESET_MOCEMM_ID_UNKNOWN/      |
|                                   |                                   |
|                                   | RBA_RESET_MOCEMM_PLAUSY_FAILED/   |
|                                   |                                   |
|                                   | RBA_RESET_MOCEMM_INITORDER        |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
